entries.54b0be3cffb41e3b: Under its management philosophy 'Sowa,' it aims to become a 'Beautiful Life Creation Company' that provides the values of 'hygiene, peace of mind and comfort,' and it plans to advance its 'Long-Term Management Vision 2030' and 'First Medium-Term Management Plan,' covering fiscal 2023 through fiscal 2030. It sets out the goal of evolving from a materials maker into a 'sanitary products maker,' and says it will work to expand its own brand of sanitary products for medical and nursing care, Kireine, and to strengthen its processing business through OEM production for customers' brands. As a joint business with Unicharm Products Co., Ltd., it plans to start an OEM business for pet care products in spring 2027.

It is explained that in the sanitary materials market, demand for adult disposable diapers continues to grow, while in baby disposable diapers, the effects of the declining birthrate and the shift to lower-cost materials are advancing, and in the food service market, the shift to lower-priced products made in China is progressing.
